blurb: Barn Owl Brewing is a craft brewery located in a 1920s dairy barn in Kelowna. They offer over 20 small-batch beers alongside local wine, cider, and non-alcoholic options. The brewery hosts live music events, run clubs, talks, and local business pop-ups.
